name: Provencal white bean and tomato stew
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and carrot in olive oil.
Stir in the tinned tomatoes and a pinch of herbes de Provence.
Add the cooked white beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Fold the chopped spinach through until wilted.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Finish with a drizzle of olive oil and serve warm.
